method: Coordinator reads retained round3 records only. Last native evaluation call:16 local microbatches per DP rank; 2 rows per microbatch. A mean losses are target-weighted; B NLL sums are divided by the same target count. No model execution.
row_identity_check: Multiset of SHA-256 prefixes used by investigator, checked against all supplied eval rows; not claimed a collision-free proof.
